gloss: progress; arrangements; way of moving; carrying

definitions.explanation: The point that a plan or process has reached, especially in the formal set phrase 〜の{運|はこ}びとなる (it has been arranged that …; the matter has reached the stage of …), used in announcements.
The way something is moved or handled: of the feet when walking ({足|あし}の{運|はこ}び), of a brush or pen ({筆|ふで}の{運|はこ}び), or of a story or argument ({話|はなし}の{運|はこ}び).
The act of carrying things, mainly in compounds such as {荷物|にもつ}{運|はこ}び and {水|みず}{運|はこ}び.

examples.japanese: ⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧⟦{開店|かいてん}→開店：14569_kaiten⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{運|はこ}び⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: The shop is now set to open next month.

examples.japanese: ⟦{両社|りょうしゃ}→両社：31608_ryousha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{合併|がっぺい}→合併：04778_gappei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{運|はこ}びとなりました。
examples.english: The two companies have reached the stage of merging.

examples.japanese: ⟦{関係者|かんけいしゃ}→関係者：16441_kankeisha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ご⟦{協力|きょうりょく}→協力：00261_kyouryoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧、⟦{無事|ぶじ}→無事：01602_buji⟧⟦{開催|かいさい}→開催：10457_kaisai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{運|はこ}びとなりましたこと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感謝|かんしゃ}→感謝：00181_kansha⟧⟦いたします→いたす：01314_itasu⟧。
examples.english: We are grateful that, thanks to everyone's cooperation, the event has been able to go ahead.

examples.japanese: ⟦{筆|ふで}→筆：03601_fude⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{運|はこ}び⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧。

⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{運|はこ}び⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦うまくて→うまい：01279_umai⟧、⟦{聞|き}いている→聞く：00483_kiku⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飽|あ}きさせない→飽きる：01815_akiru⟧。

{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}し⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{一日中|いちにちじゅう}→一日中：09519_ichinichijuu⟧⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧{運|はこ}びだった。

examples.japanese: ⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{井戸|いど}→井戸：03977_ido⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{水|みず}{運|はこ}び⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{子|こ}ども⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧だった。

notes:
The noun form of ⟦{運|はこ}ぶ→運ぶ：01088_hakobu⟧ (to carry; to proceed). Sense 1 is formal and appears in business and official announcements; the other senses are neutral.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{運|はこ}び⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: it has been arranged that …; the matter has reached the stage of …
- ⟦{足|あし}→足：00575_ashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{運|はこ}び: footwork, gait
- ⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{運|はこ}び: the way a story or discussion unfolds
- Noun + {運|はこ}び: carrying (something)
